entries.title: Numbers 34:1
segments: And the LORD spoke to Moses saying,

entries.title: Numbers 34:2
segments: Command the sons of Israel and say to them: When you come into the land of Canaan, this [is] the land that shall fall to you for an inheritance, the land of Canaan with its borders.

entries.title: Numbers 34:3
segments: And your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the border of Edom, and your south border shall be the furthest coast of the Salt Sea eastward.

entries.title: Numbers 34:4
segments: And your border shall turn from the south to the ascent of Akrabbim and pass on to Zin. And its limit shall be from the south to Kadesh-barnea, and shall go on to Hazar-addar, and pass on to Azmon.

entries.title: Numbers 34:5
segments: And the border shall turn from Azmon to the torrent of Egypt, and the end of it shall be at the sea.

entries.title: Numbers 34:6
segments: And [for] the western border, you shall even have the Great Sea for a border. This shall be your west border.

entries.title: Numbers 34:7
segments: And this shall be your northern border. From the Great Sea you shall point out for you Mount Hor.

entries.title: Numbers 34:8
segments: From Mount Hor you shall [point] your border to the entrance of Hamath. And the end of the border shall be at Zedad.

entries.title: Numbers 34:9
segments: And the border shall go on to Ziphron, and the end of it shall be at Hazar-enan. This shall be your north border.

entries.title: Numbers 34:10
segments: And you shall point out your east border from Hazar-enan to Shepham.

entries.title: Numbers 34:11
segments: And the coast shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain. And the border shall go down, and shall reach to the side of the Sea of Chinnereth eastward.

entries.title: Numbers 34:12
segments: And the border shall go down to Jordan, and the end of it shall be at the Salt Sea. This shall be your land with the borders of it all around.

entries.title: Numbers 34:13
segments: And Moses commanded the sons of Israel saying, This [is] the land which you shall inherit by lot, which the LORD commanded to give to the nine tribes and to the half tribe.

entries.title: Numbers 34:14
segments: For the tribe of the sons of Reuben according to the house of their fathers, and the tribe of the sons of Gad according to the house of their fathers. And half the tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance.

entries.title: Numbers 34:15
segments: The two tribes and the half tribe have received their inheritance on this side Jordan [at] Jericho eastward, toward the sunrise.

entries.title: Numbers 34:16
segments: And the LORD spoke to Moses saying,

entries.title: Numbers 34:17
segments: These [are] the names of the men who shall divide the land to you: Eleazar the priest and Joshua the son of Nun.

entries.title: Numbers 34:18
segments: And you shall take one ruler from every tribe, to divide the land by inheritance.

entries.title: Numbers 34:19
segments: And the names of the men [are] these. Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

entries.title: Numbers 34:20
segments: And of the tribe of the sons of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.

entries.title: Numbers 34:21
segments: And of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.

entries.title: Numbers 34:22
segments: And the ruler of the tribe of the sons of Dan, Bukki the son of Jogli.

entries.title: Numbers 34:23
segments: The ruler of the sons of Joseph, for the tribe of the sons of Manasseh, Hanniel the son of Ephod.

entries.title: Numbers 34:24
segments: And the ruler of the tribe of the sons of Ephraim, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.

entries.title: Numbers 34:25
segments: And the ruler of the tribe of the sons of Zebulun, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.

entries.title: Numbers 34:26
segments: And the ruler of the tribe of the sons of Issachar, Paltiel, the son of Azzan.

entries.title: Numbers 34:27
segments: And the ruler of the tribe of the sons of Asher, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.

entries.title: Numbers 34:28
segments: And the ruler of the tribe of the sons of Naphtali, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.

entries.title: Numbers 34:29
segments: These [are the ones] to whom the LORD commanded to divide the inheritance to the sons of Israel in the land of Canaan.
